retention.stated: the disk persists while the plan is paid; billed annually on this page

interface_detail: root SSH on KVM, with the vendor's panel for rebuild and console
chaining: the cheapest way to buy four vCPU cores; useful for a compile or crawl worker where RAM is secondary
binding_note: 2 GiB of RAM fails before the 7 TB does on almost any workload, but as a published ceiling the bandwidth quota is the number the vendor enforces.

identity_cost.detail: an account and a payment method at deploy.

confidence_note: shape, price and billing period are quoted from the plan cards read; payment and renewal are not.

evidence.proved: quoted: 'SSD VPS 2 $3.83 /MO Billed $46 per year, USD', '4 vCPU Cores', '2 GB Dedicated RAM', '60 GB Pure SSD Disk', '7 TB/Mo Bandwidth at 1 Gb/s', '1x IPv4 and 3x IPv6'
quoted for the next rung: 'SSD VPS 3 $5.75 /MO Billed $69 per year'

quoted: 'CloudCone may increase its fees for services effective the first day of a renewal term by giving notice to the customer of the new fees at least forty-five (45) days prior to the beginning of the renewal term, and if the customer does not give a notice of non-renewal as provided in Section 2 above, the customer shall be deemed to have accepted the new fee for that renewal term and any subsequent renewal terms'

quoted: 'Upon expiration of the initial term, this agreement shall automatically renew for the same length as the initial term unless CloudCone or the customer provides the other with written notice of non-renewal at least one (1) days prior to the expiration of the initial term'
quoted: 'SSD VPS 1 $2.33 /MO Billed $28 per year, USD' and 'SSD VPS 2 $3.83 /MO Billed $46 per year, USD'; neither card carries a strike-through, a promo code or a renewal rate

notes: Four vCPU for USD 3.83 a month is the best core count under the line, but only 2 GiB of RAM, so it ranks below every 4 GiB row's RAM-first metric. The displayed monthly figure is the annual total divided by twelve, which is the vendor's own arithmetic. RENEWAL PASS 2026-10-24: the annual figure is the standing product price, not a promo, so the renewal is the same USD 46 absent a notified increase. the provider do permit that increase at the start of a renewal term on 45 days' notice, and the agreement auto-renews for the same term unless cancelled at least one day before expiry. The two SSD VPS records now carry the same renewal treatment; the SSD VPS 1 record previously left renewal_usd null while SSD VPS 2 carried it, although both are priced the same way on the same page.

extras.price_arithmetic: USD 46.00 per year / 12 = USD 3.83 per month; one payment of USD 46.00
extras.renewal_note: the page prices the plan as 'Billed $46 per year', a standing annual rate rather than a discount off a higher monthly list, so the same USD 3.83 is the recurring charge. It is not locked: the provider let CloudCone raise the fee at the start of any renewal term on 45 days' notice, and silence is deemed acceptance.
extras.price_risk: bounded only by a 45-day notice; the renewal term auto-renews at the same length unless cancelled at least 1 day before expiry
